[EN] "Sure."
[ES] "Seguro."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "All right."

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Very well."

[EN] Talk to Fieri.

[EN] "It probably won't kill me."

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Taste the chef's minor surprise.

Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] It tastes a bit better, but you still think a gula and tuwangi cooked it.
[ES] Sabe un poco mejor, pero sigues pensando que un gula y un tuwangi lo cocinaron.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Maybe I'll move to Shara."
